name: Exp_ColorXADX
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXADX custom indicator, which enhances the standard ADX with advanced smoothing algorithms. It enters buy positions when the DI+ line crosses above DI- with ADX above a threshold, and sell positions on the opposite crossover, both confirmed by trend strength. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXADX自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用高级平滑算法增强了标准ADX。当DI+上穿DI-且ADX高于阈值时开多仓，反之开空仓，均需趋势强度确认。持仓使用固定止损和止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ADX趋势强度指标与DI方向线的交叉来判断趋势方向和入场时机。入场条件为：做多信号需DI+上穿DI-（即前一根DI+小于DI-，当前DI+大于DI-）且ADX值高于ExtraHighLevel阈值；做空信号则相反，DI+下穿DI-且ADX高于阈值。出场条件分为两种：止损止盈出场使用固定的点数设置（StopLoss和TakeProfit），信号反转出场则在DI线交叉时平掉反向仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，但缺少最大持仓数量限制和账户权益保护机制。策略使用T3平滑方法处理ADX数据，减少噪音信号，并通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择信号获取的K线位置。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ADX trend strength indicator combined with DI directional line crossovers to determine trend direction and entry timing. Entry conditions require: a buy signal triggers when DI+ crosses above DI- (previous DI+ was below DI-, current DI+ is above DI-) and ADX exceeds the ExtraHighLevel threshold; a sell signal triggers on the opposite crossover with the same ADX filter. Exit conditions are twofold: fixed stop loss and take profit in points handle standard exits, while signal-based exits close opposite positions when DI lines cross. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library but lacks maximum position count limits and account equity protection mechanisms. The strategy employs T3 smoothing on ADX data to reduce noise, and the SignalBar parameter allows users to select which bar index to use for signal extraction.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金份额或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money share or lot size; negative = fixed lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数
parameters.description_en: Max price slippage deviation in points

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type used for indicator calculation

parameters.name: ExtraHighLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的趋势强度阈值
parameters.description_en: Trend strength threshold for trade execution

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用ADX趋势强度过滤避免在震荡行情中频繁交易，减少假信号
支持多种高级平滑算法（T3、JJMA、JurX等），有效降低指标噪音
提供买卖开关和持仓管理开关，灵活控制交易方向和仓位操作
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易
固定止损止盈设置提供基础风险控制
pros_en: ADX trend strength filter avoids frequent trading in ranging markets, reducing false signals
Supports multiple advanced smoothing algorithms (T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to effectively reduce indicator noise
Provides buy/sell and position management toggles for flexible control over trading direction and operations
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades on the same bar
Fixed stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk control
cons: 没有持仓数量限制，可能在强趋势中反复开仓导致过度暴露
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，不适用于所有品种和波动环境
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
没有回撤保护或账户权益监控机制
信号反转时立即平仓可能过于激进，缺少缓冲区域
cons_en: No position count limit, potentially leading to over-exposure through repeated entries in strong trends
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large and not suitable for all instruments
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
Lacks drawdown protection or account equity monitoring mechanisms
Immediate position closure on signal reversal may be overly aggressive without a buffer zone
improvements: 增加最大同时持仓数量限制和最大账户回撤保护
添加点差过滤器，避免在点差过大时开仓
增加移动止损或追踪止损功能以保护浮动利润
improvements_en: Add maximum concurrent position limit and maximum account drawdown protection
Add a spread filter to prevent opening positions when spread is too wide
Add a trailing stop or break-even feature to protect floating profits

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量限制，可能在趋势行情中连续开仓导致仓位过重
固定止损止盈未根据ATR或波动性动态调整，可能导致止损过大或过小
MM参数正值模式下按存款比例计算手数，极端行情下可能导致过大仓位
risk_points_en: No position count limit, potentially leading to over-weighted positions through consecutive entries in trending markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit not dynamically adjusted based on ATR or volatility, may result in stops that are too wide or too narrow
Positive MM mode calculates lot size as a share of deposit, which may result in oversized positions during extreme market conditions
